newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia-De Beers talks extended - agency.
newsitem.headline: Russia-De Beers talks extended - agency.

text.p: Russia and De Beers will extend their latest round of talks on a new three-year diamond export deal into Saturday, Interfax news agency quoted the Russian negotiator as saying on Friday.
It said Almazy Rossii-Sakha (ARS, or Diamonds of Russia-Sakha), Russia's largest diamond producer and sole authorised exporter, which is negotiating with De Beers, had said the talks would continue.
De Beers could not be reached for comment.
Raymond Clarke, head of De Beers Consolidated Mines Ltd's Moscow representation, had said on Wednesday that talks were going well but declined to predict when they would finish.
